## Introduction

As Head of Education at IDEA and a starting PhD researcher, I am interested in combining empirical learning methodologies with computational analysis.

## Executable Python Analysis

Quarto allows running Python scripts inline. Here is a quick data visualization:

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Quick sample plot
weeks = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
engagement = [95, 88, 84, 82, 80]

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid') if 'seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid' in plt.style.available else None
plt.plot(weeks, engagement, marker='o', color='#2b5c8f')
plt.title('Student Engagement Over Time')
plt.xlabel('Week')
plt.ylabel('Active %')
plt.show()
```

## Mathematical Formalism

We can also include standard inline math equations such as $\sigma^2 = \frac{1}{N} \sum (x_i - \mu)^2$ without any LaTeX document wrapper or compilation boilerplate!
